item.title: Kotonoha Maichiru Natsu no Koe
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SILKY’S PLUS DOLCE
  • 発売日: 2018-12-21
  • スコア: 7.5/10 (101 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 言の葉舞い散る夏の風鈴
  • 英語名: Kotonoha Maichiru Natsu no Koe

あらすじ

Osamu was on his way to attend the opening ceremony at Sakuranomiya Gakuen when he heard a familiar voice. It was the super-popular voice actress Kokoro, who never shows her face, but he was able to tell due to his ability to identify anyone by their voice. Her real name was Kotoha and she was repeating her first year, just like him. Since he was her top fan, he was excited to spend his time at school with her while keeping her identity a secret between the two of them.

item.title: Hikari no Umi no Apeiria
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SILKY’S PLUS DOLCE
  • 発売日: 2017-07-28
  • スコア: 8.0/10 (533 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 景の海のアペイリア
  • 英語名: Hikari no Umi no Apeiria

别名

  • The sea of the landscape Apeiria

あらすじ

“I don’t know where you are, I don’t remember your face or name. I don’t even know if you really exist. But I promise I will find you.”

“This mail was sent from the future…”

Winter, year 2045. Kirishima Reiichi, who belongs to the AI research club, had finally succeed in developing an artificial intelligence called “Apeiria”.
